title: So Origin Kata Phuket
shortDescription: So Origin Kata is a low-rise condominium by Origin Property in Kata, Phuket.
description: So Origin Kata is a low-rise condominium by Origin Property in Kata, Phuket. Per the developer's page it has four low-rise buildings of eight storeys on about 5 rai, with 686 units. Units range from compact one-bedroom layouts to two-bedroom layouts, furnished with balconies. Shared facilities include pools, an inner courtyard, fitness and co-working areas.
